creator: Alexander Terp
description:
**Wanted:** `Pane.name_from_session` stays false for a name a person chose. Today a person's `/rename` in Claude Code is marked as taken from the session, so a client that hides those names, as Foreman does, hides the person's. A rename in Muster is not affected.

Claude Code's transcript tells the two apart: `custom-title` for a person's rename and `ai-title` for its own. Nothing reads them yet.
title: Tell a person's /rename from Claude Code's own title
